Package com.nexuslink.protocol.azure

Class AzureBlobService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.azure.AzureBlobService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class AzureBlobService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Azure Blob Storage client. Connect with a connection string (the common case, incl. the local Azurite emulator) or an account endpoint + shared key; then browse containers → blobs.

    • listChildren

      public AzureBlobService.BlobListing listChildren(String container, String prefix)
      Lists one directory level of container under prefix using the / delimiter, so virtual directories come back as sub-folders and only the immediate blobs as files. The folder-marker blob equal to the prefix itself is skipped. This is what the object-storage commander navigates.
